notes.title: Trailer and release date for Episode 4: 'Sons of Winter'
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/G22RCXlEBHc

‘Sons of Winter’ is set for release NEXT WEEK! The fourth of six episodes in the season will be available to download via Steam on Tuesday, May 26th.
 
In the meantime, check out the trailer above for a sneak peek at what the Forresters are facing next…

notes.title: Mac version is now live!
notes.notes:
We sincerely apologize for the delay and we really appreciate your patience!

We wanted to ensure that Mac users had the best game play experience possible before we released this version and unfortunately, it took more time and fine tuning than anticipated. 

Thanks again for your support!

- Telltale Games
